title: STAT3 as a Candidate Shared Regulator of the CXCR4/CXCL12 and CXCR5/CXCL13 Homing Axes in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia.
snippet: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) is characterised by the dependence of malignant cells on specialised tissue microenvironments within the bone marrow (BM) and secondary lymphoid organs (SLOs), which provide essential survival and proliferative signals.
